notes:
**A share card could claim a profit the trade did not make.** The P&L on a share card - the image that goes into a WhatsApp group, the one number in this app that leaves it - was the difference between two prices with the charges thrown away. So was the realised P&L statement shaped like a tax report. Both are after costs now, and the statement shows gross, charges and net in three columns instead of one.

**The scalper strip showed the move, not the result.** A scalper's whole result is the difference between the move and the round trip, and the running P&L counted only the move. Twenty clicks at twenty rupees each is four hundred rupees the number did not know about - on the one screen built for people making twenty clicks.

**A basket quoted premium and margin and never mentioned charges.** A four-legged condor is four brokerages plus STT on both sells before the market has moved a rupee. It is quoted now, per leg.
